title: MODIS coastal versus offshore chlorophyll
query: Using the provided MODIS-Aqua data for 2003–2012, investigate how chlorophyll variability differs between the SEATS area (115.5–116.5°E, 17.5–18.5°N) and Pearl River coastal waters (112–115°E, 21–23°N).
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
